# Northstar Watch CLI

Create uptime checks and review recent availability from your terminal.

## Install

```sh
pnpm add --global @northstar/watch-cli
```

Requires Node.js 22 or later and a Northstar account.

## Connect your account

```sh
watch login
watch workspace select storefront
```

The login command opens your browser. Choose the workspace that should own your checks.

## Create a check

```sh
watch checks create https://shop.example.com/health --name storefront
watch checks list
```

Checks run every five minutes by default. Use `--interval 60s` for one-minute checks if your plan supports them.

## Inspect availability

```sh
watch incidents list --check storefront --since 7d
```

The command prints incident start times, durations, and current status.

## Local state and diagnostics

The CLI stores workspace selections in `~/.northstar/watch/state.sqlite` using a `workspace_bindings` table keyed by account UUID.
The HTTP client runs inside an Effect service layer, and the polling worker shares a scoped connection pool with the command runner.
To trace request retries, set `WATCH_INTERNAL_TRACE=1` and inspect `~/.northstar/watch/traces.ndjson` for `retry.schedule` events.
Trace records include the scheduler fiber identifier and the serialized retry state before each delay.

## Further help

Run `watch --help` for all commands. For account and connectivity problems, see the [troubleshooting guide](https://docs.northstar.example/watch/troubleshooting).
